svg.font-family: Lilex, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.title: pyke (C++): A single-threaded perft engine built for raw throughput. It uses templates, PEXT lookup tables and AVX-512 counting, and matches exact perft counts through depth 9.
svg.text: A single-threaded perft engine built for raw throughput. It uses templates, PEXT lookup
tables and AVX-512 counting, and matches exact perft counts through depth 9.
